gloss: owner (of a building project); host (of a Buddhist service); donor

definitions.explanation: The person who orders and pays for the construction of a house or other building, as seen from the builder's side.

definitions.gloss: host (who arranges and pays for a funeral or memorial service); donor to a temple
definitions.explanation: The person who arranges and pays for a funeral or memorial service, or who makes an offering to a temple or priests.

notes:
{施|せ} (give, bestow) + {主|しゅ} (master). The word comes from Buddhism, where it named a person who gives alms; it was later extended to the person who pays for a building.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {喪主|もしゅ}: chief mourner at a funeral — the person who represents the family. At a funeral the {喪主|もしゅ} and {施主|せしゅ} are usually the same person; if not, the {施主|せしゅ} is the one who pays.
- {発注者|はっちゅうしゃ}: the party placing an order — business term for any contract, not only buildings
